stem: The town council, a group of people who make decisions about town laws and policies, is considering closing off public access to a bat cave in your town to protect the bat population that lives inside. Write a letter addressed to the town council about whether public access to the cave should be closed off.
instruction: Write a well-organized argumentative letter that uses specific evidence from the selection to support your response. Remember to — clearly state your claim, organize your writing, develop your ideas in detail, use evidence from the selection in your response, consider and include alternatives to support the argument, use correct spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and grammar. Manage your time carefully so that you can — review the selection, plan your response, write your response, revise and edit your response. Write your response in the box provided.
